# Records of the Department of State Relating to Internal Affairs of Japan, 1930–1949

> A searchable catalogue of U.S. State Department decimal file 894 (Record Group 59, U.S. National Archives), from the Scholarly Resources microfilm edition. Public domain U.S. government documents. Page images are hosted on the Internet Archive.

Please do not crawl this site's search index (`pagefind/`) page by page. All the text is available as single downloads:

## Bulk downloads

- [All OCR text, one JSON line per page (gzip, ~55 MB)](https://github.com/kmlawson/japan-internal-affairs/releases/latest/download/japan-internal-affairs-ocr-text.jsonl.gz): fields `id`, `title`, `page`, `ocr` (Mistral OCR or PaddleOCR), `archive_org` (link to the page image), `text`
- [All OCR text as one .txt per file (zip, ~58 MB)](https://github.com/kmlawson/japan-internal-affairs/releases/latest/download/japan-internal-affairs-ocr-text-files.zip): files named by ID (e.g. `894A.00-1181.txt`), each with a citation header and `=== Page N ===` blocks; `index.csv` lists them. Single files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kmlawson/japan-internal-affairs/main/text/<ID>.txt
- [Catalogue database (SQLite, ~55 MB)](https://github.com/kmlawson/japan-internal-affairs/releases/latest/download/japan-internal-affairs-catalog.sqlite): tables `files`, `subfiles` (individual documents with dates, senders, recipients, summaries), `people`, `places`, `file_keywords`, `subfile_keywords`

## Source

- [Page images and PDFs on the Internet Archive](https://archive.org/details/japan-internal-affairs-1930-1949)

## Notes

- Summaries, names and dates in the catalogue were generated by language models from OCR text and may contain errors.
- The OCR is machine-generated and contains misreadings, especially in the PaddleOCR pages.
